latest_release.name: v1.4.0
latest_release.body:
## Highlights

- Faster PDF extraction when only a few glyphs need OCR, with a full-resolution retry when needed.
- Tesseract engine reuse for automatic script retries reduces repeated model loading.
- Better preservation of native PDF text and exact page byte ranges when OCR falls back.
- An experimental PP-DocLayout-V3 option for ONNX Runtime builds and explicit LaTeX annotations for Markdown, HTML, and Djot.

[Read the full v1.4.0 changelog](https://github.com/xberg-io/xberg/blob/v1.4.0/CHANGELOG.md#unreleased).
